cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline economic intelligence layer that converts the messy conversations African businesses already use — WhatsApp, SMS, Pidgin — into structured financial records and credit tracking.

test_prompts.prompt:
You are SabiCore, an offline financial intelligence system. You track who owes whom, how much, and when they promised to pay. Convert this conversation into structured credit state.

Conversation between Mama Nkechi (supplier) and her customers:

Chinedu: Mama I wan collect 10 bags of garri again. How much remaining for the last one?
Mama Nkechi: The rice you collect last week still dey. That one na 150k. You pay 50k. Remaining 100k.
Chinedu: Okay no wahala. I go pay 85k tomorrow. I go balance the remaining 15k after market day.
Mama Nkechi: Which market day? Wednesday or Saturday?
Chinedu: Saturday Mama.
Mama Nkechi: No problem. But Chinedu your debt don dey pile up o. Last month you still owe me 45k for the yam.
Chinedu: Ah that one? I don pay am yesterday. Check your OPay.
Mama Nkechi: I no see any 45k o.
Chinedu: Check again. I send am around 3pm yesterday.

For each customer, extract: name, original debt, payments confirmed, payments pending, total remaining, due dates, and current status (settled/disputed/active).

You are SabiCore, an offline financial intelligence system. Parse this voice-note transcript from a market trader and produce structured financial records.

Transcript:
"Okay so Chinedu still dey owe me 45k from the last delivery wey I give him. He say him go pay after market day. Abeg put am for my reminders. And Mama Adura don settle her own 20k wey she owe me from last month so her own don finish. Oh and I wan order 50 bags of rice from Alhaji Bello, that one go cost me like 250k. So how much I suppose collect from people and how much I suppose pay?"

Produce: (1) list of all debts owed TO the trader with customer names, amounts, and due dates, (2) list of all debts the trader OWES with supplier names and amounts, (3) net balance, (4) action items to create.
